company.shortDescription: Nurix develops AI agents for customer engagement and enterprise workflow automation.
company.description: Nurix develops AI agents for enterprise customer engagement and workflow automation. Its systems support voice, chat, SMS, and email interactions for sales, customer support, lead qualification, collections, and other operational processes. NuPlay provides conversational AI agents for customer-facing teams, while NuStack is an enterprise workflow engine for connecting systems and automating back-office processes. Nurix also offers customized AI solutions for document processing, research, and knowledge-intensive workflows. The company integrates its agents with CRM, ticketing, payment, telephony, and internal API systems.
